en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Barqy, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There cannot happen to be the foolishness and the arrogance in the heart of a scholar’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn ‘Abdallah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi from certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner (rafa’ahu) from Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) who has said the following. “
Foolishness and arrogance are not found in the hearts of the scholars.”
